functionSettingsDescription: Enable or disable payment customization functions. Changes take effect at the next checkout.
b2bPaymentFilterDescription: Hide Klarna, Clearpay, Afterpay, and PayPal from business customers. Keep enabled to filter payment methods for B2B buyers.
b2cCodHiderDescription: Hide Cash on Delivery from consumer and guest customers. Keep enabled to prevent COD usage for non-business buyers.
